raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.12"

package:
  name: genshi
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/g/genshi/genshi-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4bca21a5a2515dabf985176be897a5b3b624626b4a9fcb648720b7c5fab71627

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - genshi
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: A toolkit for generation of output for the web
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: COPYING
  homepage: https://github.com/edgewall/genshi
  documentation: https://pythonhosted.org/Genshi/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
